about.heading: About Haideh
about.bio: Haideh Bashash is a dedicated, full-time real estate professional with HomeSmart Stars brokerage. Whether buying, selling, or leasing a property, she works tirelessly to protect her clients' best interests and guide them through every step of the process. Her business is built on dedication, clear communication, determination, and trust, with a strong belief in the philosophy of quality over quantity. Before transitioning into real estate, Haideh spent over 17 years working with the United Nations, where she gained invaluable experience interacting with people from diverse backgrounds. This background strengthened her communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills—assets she brings into her real estate practice today. Haideh is fluent in Persian and Turkish. Outside of work, she enjoys spending time with her family and friends.

contactPage.heroSubtitle: Ready to start your real estate journey? We're here to help you every step of the way.
contactPage.faqSubtitle: Common questions about our services and the real estate process.
contactPage.faq1Question: How long does the home buying process typically take?
contactPage.faq1Answer: The home buying process typically takes 30-45 days from contract to closing, depending on various factors like financing, inspections, and negotiations.
contactPage.faq2Question: Do you work with first-time homebuyers?
contactPage.faq2Answer: Absolutely! We specialize in helping first-time homebuyers navigate the process with education, guidance, and support every step of the way.
contactPage.faq3Question: What areas of Dallas do you serve?
contactPage.faq3Answer: We serve the entire Dallas metropolitan area, including Uptown, Highland Park, Lakewood, Bishop Arts, Victory Park, and surrounding neighborhoods.
contactPage.faq4Question: How do you determine the right price for my home?
contactPage.faq4Answer: We conduct a comprehensive market analysis, comparing your property to similar homes in the area, considering current market conditions, and your home's unique features.
